title: Then there is prompt injection, a malicious email, ...: The Wild Wide West of OpenClaw Agentic System Security
title_zh: 还有提示注入、一封恶意邮件……：OpenClaw智能体系统安全的狂野西部

paragraphs.en: AI-powered personal assistant frameworks such as OpenClaw combine LLM reasoning, persistent memory, tool invocation, local execution, and web-based workflows. These capabilities enable useful automation, but they also create security risks when untrusted inputs, model reasoning, tools, memory, and deployment configuration interact without explicit trust boundaries. This paper presents an empirical study of reported security concerns in OpenClaw using two complementary data sources: Reddit discussions and security-tagged GitHub issues. We analyze more than 25K Reddit posts from 13 OpenClaw-related subreddits and identify 162 security-relevant posts with 1,787 associated comments. We further collect 358 security-tagged GitHub issues and retain 180 issues describing concrete security concerns. Using qualitative analysis and evidence-grounded CWE mapping, we identify 521 CWE instances across 59 distinct weakness types, concentrated in access-control failures, sensitive-data exposure, injection, and unsafe execution. We also extract 543 practitioner mitigation suggestions and consolidate them into seven recurring strategies. To complement the empirical analysis, we present an evidence-grounded illustrative reconstruction of a representative sensitive-data exposure pathway using dummy secret values. Our findings show that OpenClaw security issues are not isolated implementation bugs; they reflect recurring trust-boundary failures across the agent execution pipeline. We discuss how these weaknesses map to both traditional software-security categories and agent-specific failure mechanisms, and derive implications for safer agentic systems, including explicit trust boundaries, least-privilege tool access, execution containment, runtime oversight, and defense-in-depth deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 OpenClaw 之类的 AI 驱动个人助手框架结合了大语言模型推理、持久化记忆、工具调用、本地执行以及基于网页的工作流。 这些能力可以实现有用的自动化，但当不可信输入、模型推理、工具、记忆和部署配置在没有明确信任边界的情况下相互交互时，它们也会带来安全风险。 本文利用两个互补的数据来源——Reddit 讨论和带有安全标签的 GitHub issue——对 OpenClaw 中报告的安全问题进行了实证研究。 我们分析了来自 13 个与 OpenClaw 相关的 subreddit 的超过 2.5 万条 Reddit 帖子，并识别出 162 条与安全相关的帖子及其关联的 1,787 条评论。 我们进一步收集了 358 个带有安全标签的 GitHub issue，并保留了其中 180 个描述具体安全问题的 issue。 通过定性分析和基于证据的 CWE 映射，我们识别出 59 种不同弱点类型下的 521 个 CWE 实例，集中于访问控制失效、敏感数据暴露、注入和不安全执行。 我们还提取了 543 条从业者的缓解建议，并将其归纳为七种反复出现的策略。 为补充实证分析，我们使用虚拟的密钥值对一个具有代表性的敏感数据暴露路径进行了基于证据的示意性重构。 我们的研究结果表明，OpenClaw 的安全问题并非孤立的实现缺陷，而是反映了智能体执行管线中反复出现的信任边界失效。 我们讨论了这些弱点如何映射到传统软件安全类别和智能体特有的失效机制，并推导出构建更安全智能体系统的启示，包括明确的信任边界、最小特权工具访问、执行隔离、运行时监督以及纵深防御部署。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly expanded beyond standalone chat-based assistants into autonomous, system-integrated agents that support complex workflows ( Dong et al., 2023 ; Ha et al., 2024 ) . These systems combine LLM reasoning with external tools, persistent memory, and system-level capabilities, enabling multi-step task execution and continuous operation ( Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . OpenClaw ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) exemplifies this paradigm as a self-hosted, tool-integrated assistant with persistent state, tool access, and direct interaction with local and web-based resources. Unlike traditional LLM applications that generate isolated responses, such agentic systems can interact with files, execute commands, invoke external services, and retain context across sessions. These capabilities enable useful automation, but they also introduce security risks when untrusted inputs, model reasoning, tools, memory, and deployment configuration interact without explicit trust boundaries ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Shan et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已迅速扩展，超越了独立的对话式助手形态，演变为支持复杂工作流的自主型、系统集成的智能体 ( Dong et al., 2023 ; Ha et al., 2024 ) 。 这些系统将 LLM 的推理能力与外部工具、持久化记忆以及系统级能力相结合，从而实现多步任务执行和持续运行 ( Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) 。 OpenClaw ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) 便是这一范式的典型代表，它是一种自托管、集成工具的助手，具备持久化状态、工具访问能力，并可直接与本地资源和网络资源交互。 与生成孤立响应的传统 LLM 应用不同，此类智能体系统可以与文件交互、执行命令、调用外部服务，并跨会话保留上下文。 这些能力带来了有用的自动化，但当不可信输入、模型推理、工具、记忆与部署配置在缺乏明确信任边界的情况下相互交互时，它们也会引入安全风险 ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Shan et al., 2026 ) 。

paragraphs.en: Many resulting failures resemble familiar software weaknesses, including improper access control, data exposure, unsafe execution, and input validation errors. Prior work identifies key risks in LLM-based and agentic systems, such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, privilege escalation, malicious skill execution, memory manipulation, and cross-context data exposure ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . However, much of this work examines risks in controlled settings, through predefined attack scenarios, or at the level of isolated components such as model outputs, generated code, or benchmark tasks ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Ayzenshteyn et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) . In deployed agent frameworks, failures often emerge from composition: untrusted inputs influence model reasoning, model outputs trigger tools, tools access local or external resources, and persistent state carries information across interactions. Thus, agentic-system security cannot be fully understood by studying the model or tool layer alone.
paragraphs.zh: 许多由此产生的故障类似于常见的软件缺陷，包括不当的访问控制、数据暴露、不安全的执行以及输入验证错误。 已有研究指出了基于大语言模型和智能体系统中的关键风险，例如提示注入、不安全的工具使用、权限提升、恶意技能执行、记忆操纵以及跨上下文数据暴露（Deng et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2025）。 然而，这些研究大多在受控环境中、通过预定义的攻击场景、或在孤立组件（如模型输出、生成的代码或基准任务）的层面上考察风险（Chen et al., 2026a；Kim et al., 2025；Ayzenshteyn et al., 2025；He et al., 2025）。 在已部署的智能体框架中，故障往往源于组合效应：不可信的输入影响模型推理，模型输出触发工具，工具访问本地或外部资源，而持久化状态则在多次交互之间传递信息。 因此，仅通过研究模型层或工具层无法完全理解智能体系统的安全性。

paragraphs.en: OpenClaw provides a timely case for studying these risks in practice. Public vulnerability records and community reports suggest that such failures are already materializing: CVE-2026-24763 reports an authenticated command-injection weakness in OpenClaw/Clawdbot Docker execution ( National Vulnerability Database, 2026 ) , while public reports document related agent-platform failures involving exposed private messages, credentials, unintended destructive actions, unauthorized data access, and misconfigured deployments ( Channel News Asia, 2026 ; Times of India, 2026 ; The Guardian, 2026 ; WIRED, 2026 ) . These reports motivate an empirical view of OpenClaw security that asks how security concerns are reported, categorized, and mitigated across a real-world agent ecosystem.
paragraphs.zh: OpenClaw 为在实践中研究这些风险提供了一个及时的案例。 公开的漏洞记录与社区报告表明，此类失败已经在成为现实：CVE-2026-24763 报告了 OpenClaw/Clawdbot Docker 执行中的一个经过身份验证的命令注入缺陷（National Vulnerability Database, 2026），同时公开报告记录了相关的智能体平台失败事件，涉及暴露的私人消息、凭据、非预期的破坏性操作、未经授权的数据访问以及配置错误的部署（Channel News Asia, 2026; Times of India, 2026; The Guardian, 2026; WIRED, 2026）。 这些报告促使我们对 OpenClaw 安全进行实证性考察，探究在真实的智能体生态系统中，安全问题是如何被报告、归类和缓解的。

paragraphs.en: For example, Figure 1 presents an evidence-grounded illustrative reconstruction of a sensitive-data exposure concern derived from anonymized Reddit report R003 . The figure uses dummy secret values to avoid exposing real credentials and is intended as a representative example rather than a separate evaluation study. The report describes a self-hosted OpenClaw setup where local configuration files may contain API keys and credentials, browser tools may process untrusted sites, and exposed gateways may leak sensitive information. Although the report maps to multiple weaknesses (CWE-200, CWE-522, CWE-284, CWE-918, and CWE-94), the figure focuses on the sensitive-data exposure pathway (CWE-200). In this pathway, a user asks OpenClaw to inspect or debug a local project. The agent may search likely configuration files, inspect environment settings, and read files containing secrets or credentials. If those values enter model reasoning or are returned in the response, sensitive workspace data can move from local configuration files into user-visible output. This example shows how OpenClaw workflows can connect local files, configuration state, model context, tools, and outputs in ways that collapse traditional trust boundaries.

paragraphs.en: Motivated by such boundary-crossing behavior, we study OpenClaw as a real-world case of security boundary failure in agentic systems. We combine two complementary sources: Reddit discussions and security-tagged GitHub issues. Reddit captures deployment-level experiences, operational failures, configuration concerns, and practitioner mitigation advice, while GitHub issues provide implementation-level evidence of weaknesses, fixes, and maintainer-side triage. We treat these sources as reports of security-relevant behavior and concerns rather than definitive ground truth for exploitable vulnerabilities.

paragraphs.en: Our work differs from prior OpenClaw-focused security analyses, which primarily study advisories, controlled attacks, layered threat models, or predefined failure scenarios ( Shan et al., 2026 ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Suwansathit et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Xu and Chen, 2026 ) . Using a mixed-methods approach (Section 3 ), we analyze more than 25K Reddit posts from 13 OpenClaw-related subreddits and 358 security-tagged GitHub issues, retaining 162 security-relevant Reddit posts and 180 validated GitHub issues for detailed analysis. This mapping yields 521 CWE instances across 59 distinct classes. We also extract 543 practitioner mitigation suggestions from Reddit comments, covering least-privilege access, isolation, monitoring, supply-chain review, credential management, human approval, and network restriction. These suggestions show that secure OpenClaw deployment requires defense-in-depth rather than a single category-specific fix.

paragraphs.en: In summary, this paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，本文做出以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: Empirical study of OpenClaw security concerns: We analyze 162 security-relevant Reddit posts and 180 GitHub issues to characterize deployment-level and implementation-level security concerns in a real-world agentic system.
paragraphs.zh: OpenClaw 安全问题的实证研究：我们分析了 162 条与安全相关的 Reddit 帖子和 180 个 GitHub issue，以刻画真实世界智能体系统在部署层面和实现层面的安全问题。

paragraphs.en: Evidence-grounded CWE mapping: We map reported issues to 521 CWE instances across 59 distinct CWE classes, providing a standardized view of recurring weakness patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 基于证据的 CWE 映射：我们将报告的问题映射到 59 个不同 CWE 类别中的 521 个 CWE 实例，从而为反复出现的缺陷模式提供了标准化的视图。

paragraphs.en: Agent-specific failure analysis: We identify how conventional weaknesses become agentic failures through interactions among model reasoning, memory, tools, plugins, credentials, and autonomous execution.
paragraphs.zh: 针对智能体的专项失败分析：我们识别了传统弱点如何通过模型推理、记忆、工具、插件、凭证与自主执行之间的交互作用，转变为智能体层面的失败。

paragraphs.en: This section reviews prior work on AI agents, personal assistant systems, and security analysis in agentic systems, then positions our study relative to recent OpenClaw security research.
paragraphs.zh: 本节回顾了有关 AI 智能体、个人助理系统以及智能体系统安全分析的相关工作，然后将我们的研究与近期的 OpenClaw 安全研究进行定位对比。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have transformed AI systems into agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool use, and persistent interaction. Systems such as Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) , ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , Toolformer ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , and Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) establish capabilities including memory, reasoning-action loops, tool invocation, feedback-driven improvement, multi-agent coordination, and reusable skill acquisition. Evaluation frameworks such as AgentBench ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) , and SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) further reflect the shift toward interactive and software-engineering task environments. However, these benchmarks do not directly evaluate security-boundary enforcement, tool-use safety, context leakage, or runtime approval in deployed agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展已将人工智能系统转变为具备推理、规划、工具使用和持续交互能力的智能体。 诸如 Generative Agents（Park et al., 2023）、ReAct（Yao et al., 2022）、Toolformer（Schick et al., 2023）、Reflexion（Shinn et al., 2023）、AutoGen（Wu et al., 2024）和 Voyager（Wang et al., 2023）等系统确立了包括记忆、推理-行动循环、工具调用、基于反馈的改进、多智能体协作以及可复用技能获取在内的多种能力。 诸如 AgentBench（Liu et al., 2023）、SWE-bench（Jimenez et al., 2023）和 SWE-agent（Yang et al., 2024）等评测框架进一步反映了向交互式和软件工程任务环境的转变。 然而，这些基准测试并未直接评估已部署智能体系统中的安全边界执行、工具使用安全、上下文泄露或运行时审批。

paragraphs.en: This progression has also led to personal AI assistants embedded into everyday workflows. paragraphs.en: OpenClaw is an agentic LLM-based assistant framework with persistent state, external inputs, memory, and tool-calling interfaces ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) . In a typical OpenClaw-like workflow, user queries and external data can be combined with conversation history, retrieved memory, and execution results. The LLM reasons over this context and may produce responses, tool calls, or parameterized action directives that are dispatched to tools connected to files, shell execution, external APIs, or communication platforms.
paragraphs.zh: OpenClaw 是一个基于大语言模型的智能体助手框架，具备持久状态、外部输入、记忆和工具调用接口（ OpenClaw, 2026 ）。 在典型的类 OpenClaw 工作流中，用户查询和外部数据可以与对话历史、检索到的记忆以及执行结果相结合。 大语言模型在此上下文上进行推理，并可能生成回复、工具调用或参数化的动作指令，这些指令会被分派到连接文件、Shell 执行、外部 API 或通信平台的工具上。

paragraphs.en: This architecture creates direct security implications. OpenClaw maintains state across sessions, processes external content alongside trusted user input, and allows model outputs to mediate system-level actions through tool dispatch. As a result, vulnerabilities can span the full inference-to-action pipeline: untrusted inputs can influence reasoning, reasoning can trigger tools, tools can access sensitive resources, and persistent memory can carry information across interactions ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Ling et al., 2026 ) . These properties make OpenClaw representative of agentic systems in which security failures arise from interactions among model behavior, tool execution, memory, and deployment configuration ( Ying et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Shan et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这种架构带来了直接的安全影响。 OpenClaw 跨会话维护状态，将外部内容与受信任的用户输入一同处理，并允许模型输出通过工具调度来介导系统级操作。 因此，漏洞可能横跨从推理到行动的完整流水线：不可信的输入可以影响推理，推理可以触发工具，工具可以访问敏感资源，而持久化记忆可以在多次交互之间携带信息（Deng et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2026；Ling et al., 2026）。 这些特性使 OpenClaw 成为智能体系统的典型代表，其安全故障源于模型行为、工具执行、记忆与部署配置之间的相互作用（Ying et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026b；Shan et al., 2026；Ma et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: The integration of AI agents expands the attack surface beyond traditional model-level risks. Recent surveys characterize vulnerability classes such as prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, memory manipulation, persistent-state corruption, and cross-component attacks ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Ling et al., 2026 ) . Empirical benchmarks and analyses further show how adversarial inputs can propagate through long-horizon planning, web-enabled interaction, and tool pipelines to trigger unsafe actions ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . These studies establish that agent vulnerabilities emerge from multi-stage execution flows, but they are often studied through predefined threat models, controlled attack scenarios, or synthetic evaluation environments.

paragraphs.en: Recent defenses and system-level analyses propose mitigations such as deception-based protection, access control, sandboxing, runtime enforcement, and human-in-the-loop validation ( Ayzenshteyn et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . These taxonomies motivate our use of an agent-specific mechanism layer in addition to CWE-based coding.

paragraphs.en: Our study complements prior work by analyzing reported security concerns from Reddit discussions and GitHub issues. Rather than starting from a predefined attack benchmark, advisory set, or framework-level threat model, we examine how OpenClaw security concerns are reported, categorized, discussed, and mitigated in practice. This evidence-driven perspective captures deployment-level failures, misconfigurations, practitioner mitigation strategies, and emergent behaviors that are often outside the scope of controlled evaluations. We further connect these reports to standardized CWE categories and agent-specific failure mechanisms, showing where traditional software weakness taxonomies are useful and where an additional agentic interpretation is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究通过分析 Reddit 讨论和 GitHub issue 中报告的安全问题，补充了已有工作。 我们并非从预定义的攻击基准、建议集合或框架级威胁模型出发，而是考察 OpenClaw 的安全问题在实践中是如何被报告、分类、讨论和缓解的。 这种证据驱动的视角捕捉到了部署层面的故障、错误配置、从业者的缓解策略以及涌现行为，而这些往往超出了受控评估的范围。 我们进一步将这些报告与标准化的 CWE 类别以及智能体特有的失效机制联系起来，说明了传统的软件缺陷分类法在哪些方面有用，以及在哪些方面需要额外的智能体化解释。

paragraphs.en: To analyze security concerns reported by users and developers, we collected evidence from two complementary sources: Reddit discussions and security-tagged GitHub issues. Both platforms have been used in prior empirical studies to examine developer discussions and software-security concerns ( Shrestha et al., 2020 ) . Reddit captures deployment-level experiences, operational failures, configuration practices, and mitigation advice from community discussions, while GitHub issues provide implementation-level evidence of weaknesses, fixes, and maintainer-side triage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了分析用户和开发者报告的安全问题，我们从两个互补的来源收集了证据：Reddit 讨论和带有安全标签的 GitHub issue。 这两个平台在此前的实证研究中均被用于考察开发者讨论和软件安全问题（Shrestha et al., 2020）。 Reddit 记录了来自社区讨论的部署层面的经验、运行故障、配置实践以及缓解建议，而 GitHub issue 则提供了关于缺陷、修复以及维护者侧分诊的实现层面的证据。

paragraphs.en: For Reddit, we collected OpenClaw-related discussions from 13 dedicated and closely related subreddits using the ArcticShift API ( Heitmann, 2026 ) . The resulting corpus contains more than 25K posts published between January and July 2026. When associated discussion threads are included, the dataset contains 175,984 total entries, covering both posts and comments. We use posts as the unit for identifying security-relevant reports and comments as the unit for extracting practitioner-proposed mitigation strategies.

paragraphs.en: The Reddit dataset contains 175,984 total entries, including more than 25K posts and their associated comments, making fully manual identification of security-relevant posts infeasible. The diverse taxonomy and free-form nature of discussions also make rule-based or static-analysis approaches less suitable, as security concerns may be implicit and context-dependent. We therefore used LLM-based filtering to identify relevant posts from their broader context. Rather than relying on an out-of-the-box model, we curated a seed set of 20 posts covering diverse concerns, including data leakage, unauthorized access, unsafe code generation, and policy or compliance risks, and used it solely for prompt development. Because false negatives are more consequential in our pipeline, the prompt prioritized recall over precision to maximize the inclusion of potentially relevant posts. We then applied the prompt independently using two open-weight models, GPT-OSS:20B and Qwen-3:32B, to provide a cross-model consistency check and reduce dependence on the behavior of a single model. We selected open-weight models to support reproducibility, local auditability, and inexpensive reruns. We retained posts identified by both models as candidate positives, using model agreement to reduce false positives before manual review, yielding 1,218 candidate posts for subsequent manual analysis.
paragraphs.zh: Reddit 数据集共包含 175,984 条记录，其中包括超过 2.5 万个帖子及其关联评论，因此完全依靠人工识别与安全相关的帖子是不可行的。 讨论的分类体系多样且形式自由，这也使得基于规则或静态分析的方法不太适用，因为安全问题可能是隐含的，并依赖于具体上下文。 因此，我们使用基于大语言模型（LLM）的过滤方法，从更广泛的上下文中识别相关帖子。 我们没有依赖现成的模型，而是整理了一个包含 20 个帖子的种子集合，涵盖多种安全问题，包括数据泄露、未授权访问、不安全的代码生成以及政策或合规风险，并仅将其用于提示词的开发。 由于假阴性在我们的流程中后果更为严重，该提示词优先考虑召回率而非精确率，以最大限度地纳入潜在相关帖子。 随后，我们使用两个开放权重模型 GPT-OSS:20B 和 Qwen-3:32B 独立应用该提示词，以提供跨模型的一致性检验，并减少对单一模型行为的依赖。 我们选择开放权重模型是为了支持可复现性、本地可审计性以及低成本的重复运行。 我们保留了被两个模型同时识别为候选正例的帖子，利用模型间的一致性在人工审核前减少假阳性，最终得到 1,218 个候选帖子供后续人工分析。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether LLM-based filtering discarded relevant security posts, we audited each model and the intersection filter on separately drawn balanced samples of 200 Reddit posts that were not used during prompt development. Table 1 reports TP, FP, TN, and FN for each audit, where FN is the critical error for our pipeline: a post marked as non-relevant by the LLM but judged security-relevant during manual review. Across all three audits, FN = 0, indicating that the evaluated filters did not miss any relevant security posts in these samples.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估基于 LLM 的过滤是否丢弃了相关的安全帖子，我们在提示词开发中未使用的、单独抽取的每组 200 条 Reddit 帖子的平衡样本上，对每个模型和交集过滤器进行了审核。 表 1 报告了每次审核的 TP、FP、TN 和 FN，其中 FN 是我们流程中的关键错误：即被 LLM 标记为不相关、但在人工审核中被判定为与安全相关的帖子。 在全部三次审核中，FN 均为 0，表明所评估的过滤器在这些样本中没有遗漏任何相关的安全帖子。

sents.zh: 为了评估基于 LLM 的过滤是否丢弃了相关的安全帖子，我们在提示词开发中未使用的、单独抽取的每组 200 条 Reddit 帖子的平衡样本上，对每个模型和交集过滤器进行了审核。

sents.en: Table 1 reports TP, FP, TN, and FN for each audit, where FN is the critical error for our pipeline: a post marked as non-relevant by the LLM but judged security-relevant during manual review.
sents.zh: 表 1 报告了每次审核的 TP、FP、TN 和 FN，其中 FN 是我们流程中的关键错误：即被 LLM 标记为不相关、但在人工审核中被判定为与安全相关的帖子。

sents.en: Across all three audits, FN = 0, indicating that the evaluated filters did not miss any relevant security posts in these samples.
sents.zh: 在全部三次审核中，FN 均为 0，表明所评估的过滤器在这些样本中没有遗漏任何相关的安全帖子。

paragraphs.en: The filters show low precision because they intentionally retain many false positives. This is acceptable for our pipeline because all LLM-positive posts were later manually reviewed, so false positives increase annotation effort but do not contaminate the final dataset. To further examine missed-post risk, we manually audited 200 randomly selected posts classified as non-relevant by both models; all 200 were confirmed as non-relevant. Overall, Table 1 supports our use of the LLM filters as recall-oriented candidate-generation tools rather than final classifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 这些过滤器的精确率较低，因为它们有意保留了大量假阳性样本。 这对我们的流水线来说是可以接受的，因为所有被 LLM 判为阳性的帖子随后都经过了人工审核，因此假阳性只会增加标注工作量，而不会污染最终数据集。 为了进一步考察漏检帖子的风险，我们人工审核了随机抽取的 200 条被两个模型均判定为不相关的帖子；这 200 条全部被确认为不相关。 总体而言，表 1 支持我们将 LLM 过滤器用作面向召回率的候选生成工具，而非最终分类器。

paragraphs.en: Because automated labels and platform-provided security tags may contain noise, we performed three manual validation tasks before analysis. First, we validated the LLM-filtered Reddit posts to remove false positives and retain only posts that described concrete OpenClaw-related security concerns. Second, we validated the security-tagged GitHub issues because repository labels may be broad or inconsistent, and not every security-labeled issue describes a concrete weakness. Third, we validated Reddit mitigation suggestions because comments often include jokes, vague opinions, tool recommendations, or non-security discussion rather than actionable security advice.
paragraphs.zh: 由于自动标注和平台提供的安全标签可能包含噪声，我们在分析前执行了三项人工验证任务。 首先，我们对经过大语言模型过滤的 Reddit 帖子进行验证，以剔除误报，仅保留描述了与 OpenClaw 相关的具体安全问题的帖子。 其次，我们对带有安全标签的 GitHub issue 进行验证，因为仓库标签可能过于宽泛或不一致，且并非每个带有安全标签的 issue 都描述了具体的弱点。 第三，我们对 Reddit 上的缓解建议进行验证，因为评论中往往包含玩笑、模糊的观点、工具推荐或与安全无关的讨论，而非可操作的安全建议。

sents.en: Third, we validated Reddit mitigation suggestions because comments often include jokes, vague opinions, tool recommendations, or non-security discussion rather than actionable security advice.

paragraphs.en: For each validation task, two annotators independently reviewed the item and assigned an inclusion or coding decision. Exact agreements were retained directly, while partial agreements and disagreements were resolved by a third annotator after reviewing the original evidence. The final validated datasets consist of 162 Reddit posts, 180 GitHub issues, and 543 mitigation suggestions.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 summarizes the validation outcomes across these three tasks. The aggregate exact agreement rate was 96.6%. We report exact agreement as the primary reliability measure because CWE mapping is multi-label and evidence-based, while mitigation coding involves both inclusion/exclusion decisions and open coding. As a secondary reliability measure, Cohen’s κ \kappa ranged from 0.875 to 0.920.

paragraphs.en: To represent the identified security concerns using a well-established security taxonomy, we mapped the validated security-relevant reports to MITRE’s Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE). CWE provides a structured vocabulary for describing and organizing software weaknesses and has been used in empirical software-engineering studies to systematically classify security concerns associated with software systems ( Lipp et al., 2022 ; Nocera et al., 2026 ) . We use CWE as a standardized vocabulary for categorizing reported weakness patterns, not to claim that every report is a verified exploitable vulnerability. A CWE label therefore means that the report contains evidence of that type of weakness; it does not imply that we independently confirmed exploitability or assigned an official vulnerability record. Annotators considered the reported behavior, affected asset, apparent root cause, and security impact, and assigned a CWE label only when the report provided supporting evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了使用一套成熟的分类体系来表示所识别出的安全问题，我们将经过验证的与安全相关的报告映射到 MITRE 的通用缺陷枚举（CWE）。 CWE 为描述和组织软件缺陷提供了结构化的词汇表，并已在实证软件工程研究中被用于系统性地分类与软件系统相关的安全问题（Lipp et al., 2022；Nocera et al., 2026）。 我们将 CWE 用作对所报告缺陷模式进行归类 的标准化词汇表，而非声称每份报告都是已验证的可利用漏洞。 因此，某个 CWE 标签意味着该报告包含此类缺陷的证据；它并不意味着我们独立确认了其可利用性或分配了官方漏洞记录。 标注者会考虑所报告的行为、受影响的资产、明显的根本原因以及安全影响，并且只有当报告提供了支持性证据时才分配 CWE 标签。

paragraphs.en: Because Reddit and GitHub reports differ in technical detail, we used a source-aware mapping strategy. Reddit posts often describe deployment-level concerns without much implementation detail, so we retained higher-level CWE identifiers when implementation details were unavailable. GitHub issues typically provide more precise technical evidence, so we prioritized specific, actionable mappings and avoided overly abstract identifiers when finer-grained CWEs applied; in several cases, CWEs were also mentioned in the issue.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 Reddit 和 GitHub 报告在技术细节上存在差异，我们采用了基于来源感知的映射策略。 Reddit 帖子通常只描述部署层面的问题而缺乏具体实现细节，因此在无法获得实现细节时，我们保留了较高层级的 CWE 标识符。 GitHub issue 通常能提供更精确的技术证据，因此我们优先采用具体、可操作的映射，并在有更细粒度的 CWE 适用时避免使用过于抽象的标识符；在某些情况下，issue 中也直接提到了相应的 CWE。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates the mapping process using a Reddit post ( R004 ) that reports multiple distinct security-relevant behaviors, including an exposed gateway interface, disabled sandboxing, plaintext credentials, and insufficient logging. Annotators first identify the reported behavior, affected assets, and trust boundaries, then derive concrete security issues. Each issue is matched against candidate CWE entries from the MITRE database, and the most specific evidence-supported CWE is selected with rationale. For example, weak access is mapped to CWE-284 because the gateway is open without access management; weak credentials are mapped to CWE-521 when the report describes weak password or pairing-code requirements; and limited auditability is mapped to CWE-778 because no audit trail is implemented. Multiple CWEs are assigned to a report only when distinct weakness mechanisms are evidenced, preventing repeated symptoms from being over-counted.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 以一个 Reddit 帖子（R004）为例展示映射过程，该帖子报告了多个不同的安全相关行为，包括暴露的网关接口、被禁用的沙箱、明文凭据以及日志记录不足。 标注人员首先识别所报告的行为、受影响的资产和信任边界，然后推导出具体的安全问题。 每个问题都与 MITRE 数据库中的候选 CWE 条目进行匹配，并选出在证据支持下最具体的 CWE，同时给出理由。 例如，弱访问被映射到 CWE-284，因为网关在缺乏访问管理的情况下对外开放；当报告描述了弱密码或弱配对码要求时，弱凭据被映射到 CWE-521；而可审计性受限被映射到 CWE-778，因为没有实现审计跟踪。 只有在存在不同弱点机制的证据时，才会为一份报告分配多个 CWE，从而防止重复出现的症状被过度计数。

paragraphs.en: This process yielded 521 CWE instances across 59 distinct CWE types: 329 from Reddit posts and 192 from GitHub issues. We further grouped these CWEs into eight higher-level categories: Access, Exposure, Injection, Execution, Secrets, Network, Resources, and Monitoring. These categories reduce sensitivity to source-specific granularity differences and support comparison between user-reported and developer-reported sources.
paragraphs.zh: 该过程共得到 521 个 CWE 实例，涵盖 59 种不同的 CWE 类型：其中 329 个来自 Reddit 帖子，192 个来自 GitHub 议题。 我们进一步将这些 CWE 归为八个更高层级的类别：访问、暴露、注入、执行、密钥、网络、资源和监控。 这些类别降低了对不同来源粒度差异的敏感性，并支持在用户报告与开发者报告这两类来源之间进行比较。

paragraphs.en: To complement CWE, we align the observed weakness categories with the AI Vulnerability Database (AVID) taxonomy. CWE provides a mature vocabulary for traditional software weaknesses, while AVID provides a taxonomy library for classifying failure evidence in general-purpose AI systems, including developer tools, end-to-end applications, and agents ( AI Risk and Vulnerability Alliance, 2026a ; AI Risk and Vulnerability Alliance, 2026b ) . We use AVID only as a secondary interpretive layer for agent-specific failure modes; the primary coding remains CWE-based.
paragraphs.zh: 为了补充 CWE，我们将观察到的缺陷类别与 AI 漏洞数据库（AVID）分类法进行对齐。 CWE 为传统软件缺陷提供了成熟的词汇体系，而 AVID 则提供了一个分类库，用于对通用 AI 系统（包括开发者工具、端到端应用和智能体）中的失效证据进行分类（AI 风险与漏洞联盟，2026a；AI 风险与漏洞联盟，2026b）。 我们仅将 AVID 作为智能体特定失效模式的辅助解释层；主要的编码仍基于 CWE。

paragraphs.en: To analyze practitioner-proposed mitigations, we examined the 1,787 comments associated with the validated Reddit posts. LLM-assisted filtering first flagged 462 comments containing potential security suggestions. We then manually validated these candidates and retained 315 comments containing actionable mitigation content.
paragraphs.zh: 为了分析从业者提出的缓解措施，我们检查了与经过验证的 Reddit 帖子相关联的 1,787 条评论。 借助大语言模型（LLM）的过滤首先标记出 462 条包含潜在安全建议的评论。 随后我们人工验证了这些候选评论，并保留了 315 条包含可操作缓解内容的评论。

sents.en: To analyze practitioner-proposed mitigations, we examined the 1,787 comments associated with the validated Reddit posts.
sents.zh: 为了分析从业者提出的缓解措施，我们检查了与经过验证的 Reddit 帖子相关联的 1,787 条评论。

sents.en: LLM-assisted filtering first flagged 462 comments containing potential security suggestions.
sents.zh: 借助大语言模型（LLM）的过滤首先标记出 462 条包含潜在安全建议的评论。

sents.en: We then manually validated these candidates and retained 315 comments containing actionable mitigation content.
sents.zh: 随后我们人工验证了这些候选评论，并保留了 315 条包含可操作缓解内容的评论。

paragraphs.en: A comment was considered actionable if it recommended a concrete deployment practice, configuration, security control, review process, access restriction, monitoring mechanism, or credential-handling practice. Vague statements, jokes, product-only recommendations without a security mechanism, and non-security discussion were excluded. Because a single comment may contain multiple mitigation actions, we extracted 543 individual mitigation suggestions from the 315 validated comments and consolidated them through iterative coding into seven high-level mitigation strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 如果一条评论推荐了具体的部署实践、配置、安全控制、审查流程、访问限制、监控机制或凭据处理实践，则该评论被视为可操作的。 模糊的陈述、玩笑、仅涉及产品但没有安全机制的建议，以及与安全无关的讨论均被排除。 由于一条评论可能包含多个缓解措施，我们从315条经过验证的评论中提取了543条单独的缓解建议，并通过迭代编码将其整合为七种高层级的缓解策略。

paragraphs.en: We first characterize reported OpenClaw security concerns using CWE as the primary structuring mechanism. Because Reddit reports often describe deployment-level behavior while GitHub issues provide more implementation detail, we interpret cross-source differences qualitatively and aggregate individual CWE labels into higher-level categories. We then use AVID as a secondary interpretive layer to connect the CWE results to AI-agent-specific failure patterns. AVID does not replace CWE in our analysis; it helps explain how conventional weakness mechanisms appear in a general-purpose AI agent system.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先以 CWE 作为主要的结构化机制，对已报道的 OpenClaw 安全问题进行刻画。 由于 Reddit 报告往往描述部署层面的行为，而 GitHub issue 提供更多实现细节，我们对跨来源差异进行定性解读，并将单个 CWE 标签聚合为更高层级的类别。 随后，我们使用 AVID 作为辅助解释层，将 CWE 结果与智能体特有的失效模式联系起来。 在我们的分析中，AVID 并不取代 CWE；它有助于解释传统弱点机制如何在通用智能体系统中出现。

paragraphs.en: Across the validated dataset, 162 Reddit posts yielded 329 CWE instances across 50 distinct CWE types, while 180 GitHub issues yielded 192 CWE instances across 41 distinct CWE types. After cross-source deduplication, the combined dataset contains 521 CWE instances across 59 unique CWE types (Table 3 ).

paragraphs.en: We group the 521 CWE instances into eight higher-level categories: Access , Exposure , Injection , Execution , Secrets , Network , Resources , and Monitoring . Table 4 summarizes the category-level distribution, most frequent CWE, and closest AVID alignment. The complete CWE distribution is provided in the supplementary material. The distribution is concentrated in a small number of categories. Access-related weaknesses are the largest group, accounting for 184 instances (35.3%). Exposure follows with 96 instances (18.4%), and Injection accounts for 87 instances (16.7%). Together, Access, Exposure, and Injection represent 70.4% of all mapped CWE instances. This concentration suggests that the reported OpenClaw risk surface is shaped primarily by failures in permission boundaries, sensitive-data handling, and the treatment of untrusted inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 521 个 CWE 实例归入八个更高级别的类别：访问、暴露、注入、执行、密钥、网络、资源和监控。 表 4 总结了类别级别的分布、最频繁出现的 CWE 以及最接近的 AVID 对应关系。 完整的 CWE 分布见补充材料。 该分布集中在少数几个类别中。 与访问相关的弱点是最大的群体，共 184 个实例（35.3%）。 暴露类次之，有 96 个实例（18.4%），注入类占 87 个实例（16.7%）。 访问、暴露和注入三类合计占所有已映射 CWE 实例的 70.4%。 这种集中分布表明，所报告的 OpenClaw 风险面主要由权限边界的失效、敏感数据的处理以及对不可信输入的处理所塑造。

paragraphs.en: The AVID alignment suggests that many OpenClaw reports sit at the boundary between conventional software security and AI-agent-specific failures. CWE captures the software weakness mechanism, while AVID helps interpret how the same weakness appears in an agentic system, such as untrusted content entering model context, skills acting as executable instructions, model-mediated disclosure of local secrets, or long-running agents consuming resources without effective oversight. The taxonomy in Table 4 also shows that OpenClaw weaknesses arise at agentic interaction boundaries rather than in isolated components. Across access, secrets, injection, exposure, execution, resources, and monitoring, the CWE–AVID alignment captures how authority, data, tools, external content, and autonomous workflows move through the agent pipeline. Section 5 and Table 5 further synthesize these boundary failures into agent-specific mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: AVID 对齐分析表明，许多 OpenClaw 报告处于传统软件安全与 AI 智能体特有失效之间的边界地带。 CWE 刻画的是软件弱点机制，而 AVID 有助于解释同一弱点在智能体系统中的表现形式，例如不可信内容进入模型上下文、技能充当可执行指令、模型介导的本地机密泄露，或长时间运行的智能体在缺乏有效监督的情况下消耗资源。 表 4 中的分类体系还表明，OpenClaw 的弱点产生于智能体交互边界，而非孤立组件之中。 跨越访问、机密、注入、暴露、执行、资源和监控等类别，CWE–AVID 对齐刻画了权限、数据、工具、外部内容和自主工作流如何在智能体流水线中流转。 第 5 节和表 5 进一步将这些边界失效归纳为智能体特有的机制。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates representative failure scenarios for the eight CWE-derived categories discussed below.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了下文讨论的八个源自 CWE 的类别的典型失败场景。

paragraphs.en: Access-related weaknesses include authentication, authorization, and privilege-management failures. As shown in Figure 4(a) , reports describe exposed gateways, weak authentication, permissive defaults, and agents acting beyond intended permission boundaries. These failures are consequential because broad access can enable downstream tool invocation, file access, message sending, or external service interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 访问相关的弱点包括身份验证、授权和权限管理方面的失效。 如图 4(a) 所示，报告描述了暴露的网关、薄弱的身份验证、过于宽松的默认配置，以及智能体的行为超出预期权限边界的情况。 这些失效之所以影响重大，是因为广泛的访问权限可能导致下游工具调用、文件访问、消息发送或外部服务交互。

sents.en: Access-related weaknesses include authentication, authorization, and privilege-management failures.
sents.zh: 访问相关的弱点包括身份验证、授权和权限管理方面的失效。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 4(a) , reports describe exposed gateways, weak authentication, permissive defaults, and agents acting beyond intended permission boundaries.
sents.zh: 如图 4(a) 所示，报告描述了暴露的网关、薄弱的身份验证、过于宽松的默认配置，以及智能体的行为超出预期权限边界的情况。

paragraphs.en: O1 Access is the dominant category, accounting for 35.3% of all mapped CWE instances.
paragraphs.zh: O1 访问（Access）是占主导地位的类别，占所有已映射 CWE 实例的 35.3%。

paragraphs.en: Exposure-related weaknesses involve sensitive data becoming visible through unintended users, tools, logs, model contexts, dashboards, or external services. Figure 4(b) shows how sensitive data can propagate from memory or resources to unintended outputs. Reports commonly mention API keys, credentials, chats, configuration files, and workspace data.
paragraphs.zh: 与暴露相关的弱点涉及敏感数据通过非预期的用户、工具、日志、模型上下文、仪表板或外部服务变得可见。 图4(b)展示了敏感数据如何从内存或资源传播到非预期的输出。 报告中经常提到API密钥、凭据、聊天记录、配置文件和工作区数据。

sents.en: Exposure-related weaknesses involve sensitive data becoming visible through unintended users, tools, logs, model contexts, dashboards, or external services.
sents.zh: 与暴露相关的弱点涉及敏感数据通过非预期的用户、工具、日志、模型上下文、仪表板或外部服务变得可见。

sents.en: Figure 4(b) shows how sensitive data can propagate from memory or resources to unintended outputs.
sents.zh: 图4(b)展示了敏感数据如何从内存或资源传播到非预期的输出。

sents.en: Reports commonly mention API keys, credentials, chats, configuration files, and workspace data.
sents.zh: 报告中经常提到API密钥、凭据、聊天记录、配置文件和工作区数据。

paragraphs.en: O2 Exposure is the second-largest category, accounting for 18.4% of mapped CWE instances.
paragraphs.zh: O2 暴露是第二大类别，占已映射 CWE 实例的 18.4%。

paragraphs.en: Injection-related weaknesses occur when untrusted content is insufficiently separated from instructions, tool parameters, rendered content, or model context. As shown in Figure 4(c) , malicious external content can influence model reasoning and downstream actions. Reddit reports emphasize prompt-injection-style risks, while GitHub issues more often capture validation or sanitization flaws.
paragraphs.zh: 当不可信内容未能与指令、工具参数、渲染内容或模型上下文充分分离时，就会出现与注入相关的弱点。 如图 4(c) 所示，恶意外部内容可以影响模型推理和下游操作。 Reddit 报告强调的是提示注入类的风险，而 GitHub 问题更多记录的是验证或清理方面的缺陷。

sents.en: Injection-related weaknesses occur when untrusted content is insufficiently separated from instructions, tool parameters, rendered content, or model context.
sents.zh: 当不可信内容未能与指令、工具参数、渲染内容或模型上下文充分分离时，就会出现与注入相关的弱点。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 4(c) , malicious external content can influence model reasoning and downstream actions.
sents.zh: 如图 4(c) 所示，恶意外部内容可以影响模型推理和下游操作。

sents.en: Reddit reports emphasize prompt-injection-style risks, while GitHub issues more often capture validation or sanitization flaws.
sents.zh: Reddit 报告强调的是提示注入类的风险，而 GitHub 问题更多记录的是验证或清理方面的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: O3 Injection-related weaknesses span multiple layers, from prompt interpretation to tool execution, and account for 16.7% of mapped CWE instances.
paragraphs.zh: O3 注入相关的弱点跨越多个层面，从提示词解释到工具执行，占已映射 CWE 实例的 16.7%。

paragraphs.en: Execution-related weaknesses involve unsafe skill installation, untrusted dependencies, malicious plugins, and supply-chain risks. Figures 4(d) and 4(e) illustrate two pathways: unsafe system-level action and untrusted skill installation. Although less frequent than Access, Exposure, and Injection, these weaknesses are high impact because they can turn upstream trust failures into code execution, credential theft, or persistent compromise.
paragraphs.zh: 执行相关的弱点涉及不安全的技能安装、不受信任的依赖、恶意插件以及供应链风险。 图4(d)和图4(e)展示了两种路径：不安全的系统级操作和不受信任的技能安装。 尽管相比访问、暴露和注入类弱点出现频率较低，这些弱点影响重大，因为它们能将上游的信任失效转化为代码执行、凭据窃取或持续性入侵。

sents.en: Execution-related weaknesses involve unsafe skill installation, untrusted dependencies, malicious plugins, and supply-chain risks.
sents.zh: 执行相关的弱点涉及不安全的技能安装、不受信任的依赖、恶意插件以及供应链风险。

sents.en: Figures 4(d) and 4(e) illustrate two pathways: unsafe system-level action and untrusted skill installation.
sents.zh: 图4(d)和图4(e)展示了两种路径：不安全的系统级操作和不受信任的技能安装。

sents.en: Although less frequent than Access, Exposure, and Injection, these weaknesses are high impact because they can turn upstream trust failures into code execution, credential theft, or persistent compromise.

paragraphs.en: O4 Execution accounts for 11.7% of mapped CWE instances, but remains high impact because untrusted skills, plugins, and dependencies can inherit agent privileges.
paragraphs.zh: O4 执行类占已映射 CWE 实例的 11.7%，但影响仍然很高，因为不受信任的技能、插件和依赖项可能继承智能体的权限。

paragraphs.en: Secrets-related weaknesses involve API keys, tokens, credentials, cryptographic material, and insecure communication or storage paths through which such secrets may be exposed. Figure 4(f) shows how insecure secret handling can expose credentials through files, logs, communication channels, or agent-readable context. These issues are important because OpenClaw deployments often centralize credentials for LLM providers, messaging platforms, plugins, and local services.
paragraphs.zh: 与机密相关的弱点涉及 API 密钥、令牌、凭证、密码学材料，以及可能泄露此类机密的不安全通信或存储路径。 图 4(f) 展示了不安全的机密处理如何通过文件、日志、通信渠道或智能体可读取的上下文暴露凭证。 这些问题之所以重要，是因为 OpenClaw 部署通常为 LLM 提供商、消息平台、插件和本地服务集中管理凭证。

sents.en: Figure 4(f) shows how insecure secret handling can expose credentials through files, logs, communication channels, or agent-readable context.
sents.zh: 图 4(f) 展示了不安全的机密处理如何通过文件、日志、通信渠道或智能体可读取的上下文暴露凭证。

sents.zh: 这些问题之所以重要，是因为 OpenClaw 部署通常为 LLM 提供商、消息平台、插件和本地服务集中管理凭证。

paragraphs.en: O5 Secrets-related weaknesses account for 6.7% of mapped CWE instances.
paragraphs.zh: O5 与秘密（Secrets）相关的弱点占已映射 CWE 实例的 6.7%。

paragraphs.en: Network weaknesses include exposed services, unsafe binding, SSRF-like behavior, open-proxy behavior through skills or plugins, and weak restrictions on inbound or outbound communication. Figure 4(g) shows how network exposure can connect external inputs or public endpoints to local agent capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 网络弱点包括暴露的服务、不安全的绑定、类似 SSRF 的行为、通过技能或插件产生的开放代理行为，以及对入站或出站通信的限制过弱。 图 4(g) 展示了网络暴露如何将外部输入或公共端点连接到本地智能体能力。

sents.en: Network weaknesses include exposed services, unsafe binding, SSRF-like behavior, open-proxy behavior through skills or plugins, and weak restrictions on inbound or outbound communication.
sents.zh: 网络弱点包括暴露的服务、不安全的绑定、类似 SSRF 的行为、通过技能或插件产生的开放代理行为，以及对入站或出站通信的限制过弱。

sents.en: Figure 4(g) shows how network exposure can connect external inputs or public endpoints to local agent capabilities.
sents.zh: 图 4(g) 展示了网络暴露如何将外部输入或公共端点连接到本地智能体能力。

paragraphs.en: Together, Reddit and GitHub show complementary views of the same risk surface: Reddit emphasizes deployment-level failures and practitioner experience, while GitHub provides implementation-level evidence. paragraphs.en: The CWE and AVID mappings identify the weakness types observed in OpenClaw reports, but they do not fully explain why these weaknesses become risky in an agentic system. OpenClaw combines natural-language instructions, persistent context, external tools, local execution, third-party skills, and deployment configuration into a single action pipeline. As a result, weaknesses can propagate across layers: untrusted content can influence reasoning, reasoning can trigger tools, tools can access sensitive resources, and missing audit trails can obscure the resulting actions.
paragraphs.zh: CWE 与 AVID 的映射识别出了 OpenClaw 报告中观察到的缺陷类型，但它们并不能完全解释为什么这些缺陷在智能体系统中会变得危险。 OpenClaw 将自然语言指令、持久化上下文、外部工具、本地执行、第三方技能以及部署配置整合进单一的动作流水线中。 因此，缺陷可能会跨层传播：不可信的内容可以影响推理，推理可以触发工具，工具可以访问敏感资源，而缺失的审计轨迹则可能掩盖由此产生的行为。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 synthesizes the observations from Section 4 into six agent-specific failure mechanisms. These mechanisms are not additional coding labels; rather, they explain how the observed CWE categories interact across model reasoning, context construction, tool invocation, execution privileges, and deployment boundaries. These mechanisms show that the observed weaknesses are not merely ordinary software bugs appearing in a new application. Their impact is amplified by the agent execution pipeline. Access failures can expose tool-mediated actions; injection can influence reasoning; exposure can occur through model context; execution risks can arrive through skills and plugins; resource bugs can be amplified by autonomy; and weak monitoring can make all of these failures harder to detect or reconstruct.
paragraphs.zh: 表5将第4节中的观察结果归纳为六种智能体特有的失效机制。 这些机制并不是额外的编码标签；而是解释了所观察到的CWE类别如何在模型推理、上下文构建、工具调用、执行权限和部署边界之间相互作用。 这些机制表明，所观察到的弱点并非仅仅是出现在新应用场景中的普通软件缺陷。 其影响会被智能体执行流水线放大。 访问类失效可能暴露经由工具执行的操作；注入可能影响推理；泄露可能通过模型上下文发生；执行风险可能通过技能和插件引入；资源类缺陷可能因自主性而被放大；而薄弱的监控则可能使所有这些失效更难被检测或还原。

paragraphs.en: This analysis motivates three design implications for OpenClaw-like systems. First, trust boundaries must be explicit across input ingestion, context construction, reasoning, tool selection, execution, memory, and output generation. Second, authority should be scoped dynamically at the level of tools, actions, and tasks rather than granted broadly to the agent process. Third, agent actions must be observable and reviewable, especially when they affect files, credentials, external services, or long-running workflows. These implications inform the mitigation analysis in Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 这一分析为类 OpenClaw 系统引出了三条设计启示。 首先，信任边界必须在输入摄取、上下文构建、推理、工具选择、执行、记忆和输出生成的各个环节中保持明确。 其次，权限应在工具、动作和任务层面进行动态限定，而不是宽泛地授予智能体进程。 第三，智能体的动作必须可观察、可审查，尤其是当它们影响文件、凭据、外部服务或长时间运行的工作流时。 这些启示为第 6 节的缓解措施分析提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: Beyond diagnosing reported weaknesses, practitioners also propose strategies for reducing OpenClaw security risks. We analyze Reddit mitigation suggestions and use selected GitHub issues as implementation-level examples where relevant. From the 1,787 comments associated with validated Reddit posts, LLM-assisted filtering flagged 462 comments as potentially containing actionable security suggestions. Manual validation retained 315 comments, from which we extracted 543 mitigation suggestions and consolidated them into seven high-level strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 除了诊断已报告的弱点之外，从业者还提出了降低 OpenClaw 安全风险的策略。 我们分析了 Reddit 上的缓解建议，并在相关之处使用选定的 GitHub issue 作为实现层面的示例。 在与已验证 Reddit 帖子关联的 1,787 条评论中，LLM 辅助筛选将 462 条评论标记为可能包含可操作的安全建议。 人工验证保留了 315 条评论，我们从中提取了 543 条缓解建议，并将其归纳为七项高层策略。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 summarizes the seven mitigation strategies, their relative frequency, representative recommended approaches, and example practitioner comments. The most frequent strategies are Access Control and Least Privilege (27%), Environment Isolation and Execution Containment (17%), Monitoring, Auditing, and Runtime Defense (14%), and Supply Chain and Skill/Plugin Trust (12%). Credential and Secret Management, Human Oversight and Control Mechanisms, and Network Security and Exposure Reduction each account for 10%.
paragraphs.zh: 图5总结了七种缓解策略、它们的相对频率、具有代表性的推荐方法以及从业者评论的示例。 最常见的策略是访问控制与最小权限（27%）、环境隔离与执行遏制（17%）、监控、审计与运行时防御（14%），以及供应链与技能/插件信任（12%）。 凭据与密钥管理、人类监督与控制机制、以及网络安全与暴露面缩减各占10%。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows that mitigation strategies are cross-cutting rather than category-specific. Access Control and Least Privilege is most strongly linked to the Access category, but isolation, monitoring, credential handling, network restriction, and human approval also connect to multiple weakness categories. This pattern suggests that secure OpenClaw deployment requires layered controls rather than single-point fixes.
paragraphs.zh: 图6显示，缓解策略是跨类别的，而非针对特定类别的。 访问控制与最小权限与访问类别的关联最强，但隔离、监控、凭证处理、网络限制以及人工审批也与多个弱点类别相关联。 这一模式表明，OpenClaw 的安全部署需要分层控制，而非单点修复。

paragraphs.en: Credential and secret management strategies reduce exposure and misuse of API keys, tokens, login data, and cryptographic material. These suggestions align with Secrets and Exposure weaknesses (O2, O5). Practitioners emphasize avoiding real credentials in experimental deployments, scoping credentials per service, and preventing secrets from being reachable through prompts, logs, files, or tool outputs. A credential that is safe in one context may become dangerous when combined with untrusted input, broad tool access, or model-generated actions.

paragraphs.en: Network security strategies reduce external attack surface by limiting public exposure, restricting ingress, and avoiding unsafe default bindings. These mitigations address Network and Access weaknesses (O1, O6), especially when agent interfaces can trigger downstream tool or file access. GitHub issue #22226 reflects a related deployment-boundary problem, where Docker gateway binding, local-connection checks, and device-pairing scopes interacted in a way that affected secure multi-agent communication. Overall, network restriction remains a practical first line of defense for preventing externally reachable agent interfaces from becoming entry points into local or internal resources.

paragraphs.en: Trust-boundary failures are harder than hygiene gaps. Some observed weaknesses reflect conventional security hygiene gaps: Secrets (O5, 6.7%), Network exposure (O6, 4.2%), Resources (O7, 3.5%), and Monitoring (O8, 3.5%) map to established controls such as scoped secrets, segmentation, resource limits, logging, and auditability. By contrast, Access (O1, 35.3%), Injection (O3, 16.7%), and Execution (O4, 11.7%) are more structural to the agent execution model because permissions are exercised through tool selection, untrusted content may enter prompt or memory context, and model outputs can trigger privileged actions. Exposure (O2, 18.4%) often appears as a downstream symptom of unresolved access, context, or injection failures. This suggests that OpenClaw-like systems need both conventional hardening and agent-specific primitives for dynamic authorization, instruction/data separation, and context-aware execution control.
paragraphs.zh: 信任边界类故障比常规安全卫生类缺陷更难处理。 一些被观察到的弱点反映的是常规的安全卫生缺陷：密钥管理（O5，6.7%）、网络暴露（O6，4.2%）、资源（O7，3.5%）和监控（O8，3.5%）对应于成熟的安全控制措施，例如限定作用域的密钥、网络分段、资源限制、日志记录和可审计性。 相比之下，访问控制（O1，35.3%）、注入（O3，16.7%）和执行（O4，11.7%）对智能体执行模型而言更具结构性问题，因为权限是通过工具选择来行使的，不可信内容可能进入提示或记忆上下文，而模型输出可能触发特权操作。 暴露（O2，18.4%）通常表现为未能解决的访问控制、上下文或注入故障的下游症状。 这表明类 OpenClaw 系统既需要常规的安全加固，也需要针对智能体的专用原语，用于动态授权、指令/数据分离以及上下文感知的执行控制。

paragraphs.en: Access dominates the surface, while execution amplifies damage. Access concerns account for the largest share of observed issues (O1), but execution-related failures (O4) can drive high-impact outcomes because they connect agent decisions to system-level actions. Supplementary CWE–CVE and advisory evidence suggests that access bypass and unsafe execution are recurring classes that may interact within broader attack paths. Together, these findings point to a dual requirement: access must be tightly scoped and continuously enforced at runtime, while execution pathways—especially tool invocation, plugin handling, and skill installation—must be treated as high-risk operations requiring validation, containment, and policy-aware control.
paragraphs.zh: 访问占据表层，而执行放大危害。 访问类问题在已观察到的问题中占比最大（O1），但与执行相关的故障（O4）可能造成高影响后果，因为它们将智能体的决策与系统级操作连接了起来。 补充的 CWE–CVE 和安全公告证据表明，访问绕过与不安全执行是反复出现的类别，并且可能在更广泛的攻击路径中相互作用。 综合来看，这些发现指向双重要求：访问必须在运行时被严格限定范围并持续执行，而执行路径——尤其是工具调用、插件处理和技能安装——必须被视为需要验证、遏制和策略感知控制的高风险操作。

paragraphs.en: Defense-in-depth must be integrated into the agent, not left to users. The mitigation findings show that practitioners already recommend familiar controls: least privilege (M1), isolation (M2), monitoring (M3), supply-chain review (M4), credential scoping (M5), human approval (M6), and network restriction (M7). However, the recurrence of these suggestions indicates that users often compensate for missing or weak built-in safeguards. This is especially important for agentic systems, where a single failure can cross boundaries: untrusted content can influence reasoning, reasoning can trigger tools, tools can access secrets or files, and weak monitoring can obscure the action sequence. Secure OpenClaw-like systems should therefore make these controls default, composable, and task-aware rather than optional deployment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 纵深防御必须内置于智能体之中，而不能留给用户处理。 缓解措施的调研结果表明，从业者已经在推荐熟悉的控制手段：最小权限（M1）、隔离（M2）、监控（M3）、供应链审查（M4）、凭证范围限定（M5）、人工审批（M6）以及网络限制（M7）。 然而，这些建议的反复出现说明，用户往往在弥补智能体缺失或薄弱的内置防护。 这对智能体系统尤为重要，因为在这类系统中，单次故障可能跨越多个边界：不可信内容可以影响推理，推理可以触发工具，工具可以访问机密或文件，而薄弱的监控则可能掩盖整个操作序列。 因此，类似 OpenClaw 的安全系统应当使这些控制手段成为默认、可组合且具备任务感知能力的配置，而不是可选的部署建议。

paragraphs.en: Validation and approval must occur before execution, not only after failure. Injection and exposure weaknesses (O2, O3) show that OpenClaw processes untrusted content that can influence reasoning, memory, and execution. These risks extend beyond external inputs: model-generated outputs can also act as implicit execution triggers when passed to tools or workflows. Practitioner mitigations similarly emphasize runtime inspection, tracing, and approval before high-risk operations (M3, M6). Therefore, agentic systems need validation at two points: before external content enters trusted context, and before generated actions are executed. This shifts security enforcement from static configuration toward runtime policy checks over context, tools, parameters, and intended effects.
paragraphs.zh: 验证与审批必须在执行之前进行，而不能仅在失败之后才进行。 注入与暴露弱点（O2、O3）表明，OpenClaw 会处理可能影响推理、记忆和执行的不受信任内容。 这些风险不仅限于外部输入：模型生成的输出在传递给工具或工作流时，也可能成为隐式的执行触发器。 实践者的缓解措施同样强调在执行高风险操作之前进行运行时检查、追踪和审批（M3、M6）。 因此，智能体系统需要在两个时点进行验证：一是在外部内容进入受信任上下文之前，二是在生成的动作被执行之前。 这将安全执行从静态配置转变为针对上下文、工具、参数和预期效果的运行时策略检查。

paragraphs.en: OpenClaw security is evolving and structurally interconnected. Security issues in OpenClaw are neither static nor isolated. Advisory and CVE evidence in the supplementary material indicates continuing reports and uneven resolution patterns across severity levels. Figure 7 summarizes these trends, showing weekly advisory activity, severity-wise resolution rate, and average resolution time. These trends suggest that prioritization cannot rely on severity alone; it must also consider how weaknesses interact across access control, execution, filesystem access, network communication, and monitoring. The combined CWE, AVID, and agent-specific mechanism analyses show that OpenClaw operates within an evolving threat landscape where small configuration or validation gaps can propagate through the agent pipeline. Continuous monitoring, transparent triage, and system-level mitigation are therefore necessary for safer deployment.
paragraphs.zh: OpenClaw 的安全性处于不断演变之中，且在结构上相互关联。 OpenClaw 的安全问题既不是静态的，也不是孤立的。 补充材料中的安全通告和 CVE 证据表明，安全报告持续不断，且不同严重程度级别的问题解决情况并不均衡。 图 7 总结了这些趋势，展示了每周安全通告活动、按严重程度划分的解决率以及平均解决时间。 这些趋势表明，优先级排序不能仅依赖严重程度，还必须考虑各类弱点在访问控制、执行、文件系统访问、网络通信和监控之间的相互作用。 综合的 CWE、AVID 以及智能体特定机制分析表明，OpenClaw 运行在不断演变的威胁环境之中，微小的配置或验证缺口都可能沿着智能体流水线传播。 因此，要实现更安全的部署，持续的监控、透明的分诊以及系统层面的缓解措施都是必不可少的。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. Our analysis relies on public Reddit reports and GitHub issues, which may lack complete configuration details, exploit evidence, or root-cause information. We therefore treat them as reports of security-relevant behavior, concerns, misconfigurations, and implementation weaknesses rather than confirmed exploitable vulnerabilities. We mitigate this risk through evidence-grounded CWE mapping, conservative ambiguity handling, cross-source comparison, and advisory/CVE context where available.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度。 我们的分析依赖于公开的 Reddit 报告和 GitHub issue，这些来源可能缺乏完整的配置细节、漏洞利用证据或根因信息。 因此，我们将它们视为与安全相关的行为、隐患、错误配置和实现弱点的报告，而非已确认的可利用漏洞。 我们通过基于证据的 CWE 映射、保守的歧义处理、跨来源比对，以及在可用时参考公告/CVE 背景，来缓解这一风险。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. LLM-assisted filtering may miss relevant Reddit posts. To reduce this risk, we used a frozen recall-oriented prompt, two independent open-weight models, manual validation of all LLM-positive candidates, and filter audits. The audited samples showed no false negatives, and a separate audit of 200 posts excluded by both models found no missed relevant posts. Because these audits are sample-based, our counts should be interpreted as lower-bound estimates rather than exhaustive coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 借助大语言模型（LLM）进行筛选可能会遗漏相关的 Reddit 帖子。 为降低这一风险，我们采用了固定的召回导向提示词、两个独立的开放权重模型、对所有 LLM 判为阳性的候选帖子进行人工验证，以及对过滤器进行审计。 被审计的样本中没有出现假阴性，此外对被两个模型同时排除的 200 条帖子进行的单独审计也没有发现被遗漏的相关帖子。 由于这些审计是基于抽样的，我们的计数应被解释为下限估计，而非穷尽性的覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Coding validity. CWE assignment and mitigation coding involve judgment, especially for low-detail Reddit reports and practitioner comments. We mitigate this through source-aware mapping rules, conservative ambiguity handling, two-annotator review, third-author resolution, and documented coding criteria. Across the three validation tasks, exact agreement was 96.6%, with Cohen’s κ \kappa ranging from 0.875 to 0.920. AVID is used only as a secondary interpretive layer, not as an official vulnerability assignment or replacement for CWE.

paragraphs.en: We presented an empirical study of reported security concerns in OpenClaw using Reddit discussions and security-tagged GitHub issues. Our analysis covers 162 security-relevant Reddit posts with 1,787 associated comments and 180 validated GitHub issues. Through evidence-grounded CWE mapping, we identified 521 CWE instances across 59 distinct weakness types, with recurring concentrations in access control, sensitive-data exposure, injection, and unsafe execution. These results show that OpenClaw security concerns are shaped by recurring trust-boundary failures rather than isolated implementation bugs. Beyond cataloging conventional weaknesses, we synthesize agent-specific failure mechanisms showing how familiar issues become amplified when model reasoning, persistent memory, tool invocation, third-party skills, credentials, and local execution interact within the same pipeline. We also analyze 543 practitioner-proposed mitigation suggestions and consolidate them into seven defense strategies, including least privilege, isolation, monitoring, supply-chain review, credential management, human approval, and network restriction. Together, these findings suggest that safer OpenClaw-like systems require defense-in-depth controls that are built into the agent pipeline, rather than left only as deployment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 Reddit 讨论和带有安全标签的 GitHub issue，对 OpenClaw 中报告的安全问题进行了一项实证研究。 我们的分析涵盖了 162 个与安全相关的 Reddit 帖子（包含 1,787 条相关评论）以及 180 个经验证的 GitHub issue。 通过基于证据的 CWE 映射，我们识别出 59 种不同弱点类型下的 521 个 CWE 实例，其中反复集中于访问控制、敏感数据暴露、注入和不安全执行。 这些结果表明，OpenClaw 的安全问题是由反复出现的信任边界失效所塑造的，而非孤立的实现缺陷。 除了对常规弱点进行编目之外，我们还综合归纳了智能体特有的失效机制，展示当模型推理、持久记忆、工具调用、第三方技能、凭据与本地执行在同一流水线中交互时，常见问题如何被放大。 我们还分析了 543 条由从业者提出的缓解建议，并将其整合为七种防御策略，包括最小权限、隔离、监控、供应链审查、凭据管理、人工审批和网络限制。 总体而言，这些发现表明，更安全的类 OpenClaw 系统需要将纵深防御控制内建于智能体流水线之中，而不是仅作为部署建议保留。
